item.title: Life in Retirement: Ask a kid how I should challenge myself
item.description: It was taking a bit of a risk asking Charlie Stuart what she thought I should do as a challenge to myself as I approach my 65th birthday. She’s a bit of an intimidating eight year-old, after all, having been written up in the Red Deer Advocate for her generous donation of toys to the Christmas Wish Breakfast.
